modern: Short is the little of life that remains to you. Live as if on a mountain. For it makes no difference whether a man lives there or here, if he lives everywhere in the world as in a state, a political community. Let men see, let them know a real man who lives according to nature. If they cannot endure him, let them kill him. For that is better than to live in that way, as men do.
original: Short is the little which remains to thee of life. Live as on a mountain. For it makes no difference whether a man lives there or here, if he lives everywhere in the world as in a state [political community]. Let me see, let them know a real man who lives according to nature. If they cannot endure him, let them kill him. For that is better than to live thus [as men do].
